name: image-generation-plugin
description: Adds image generation to chat and agent workflows via DALL-E 3, Flux, and Stable Diffusion. Registers the generate_image tool callable from LLC agent tasks.
author: mrveiss

default_provider.description: Default provider used when none is specified in the tool call

required_env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
required_env.description: OpenAI API key for DALL-E image generation
obtain_steps: Set OPENAI_API_KEY to the generated key

required_env.name: FLUX_API_KEY
required_env.description: BFL API key for Flux image generation (api.bfl.ml)
obtain_steps: Sign up and obtain an API key
Set FLUX_API_KEY to the generated key

required_env.name: STABILITY_API_KEY
required_env.description: Stability AI API key for Stable Diffusion image generation
obtain_steps: Set STABILITY_API_KEY to the generated key
